requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Solution
requirements.Description: Develop HP’s first business ink tank printer tailored for SMBs, offering cost-effective, high-performance color printing with minimal intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses gap in HP portfolio for CISS PLE Hi segment and competitive risk of losing SMB market share.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: A new business ink tank printer is launched and available for SMB customers with specified performance and cost-efficiency metrics.
requirements.citation: Magellan MRD, Page 4, Page 6, Page 7, Page 11, Page 12

requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI features for productivity, including Perfect Print, Perfect Scan, and AI-driven workflow and device management solutions.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require easy-to-use, efficient tools to manage printing and scanning without IT expertise.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI solutions for print and scan are available; SMB portal includes AI-driven device management and workflow features.
requirements.citation: Magellan MRD, Page 4, Page 7, Page 10, Page 11

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for SMBs to manage multiple printers, including monitoring, support, and workflow tools.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged and lightly managed SMBs need an easy, centralized way to manage their printers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is accessible to SMB customers, supports device management for at least 6-15 printers, includes monitoring and support features.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer delivers HP’s lowest total cost of ownership (TCO) for SMBs, including reduced intervention, cost-efficient supplies, and maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs prioritize ROI and efficiency; competitive advantage vs. rivals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO is demonstrably lower than HP’s previous business printers and competitive models, validated by cost analysis.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design a maintenance box that is replaceable by the customer, reducing downtime and service intervention.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT; self-service reduces operational disruption and increases satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by end-user without technical support; validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Offer warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever comes first) and ensure serviceability with customer replaceable parts and service center support.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs expect reliable products with clear service options and minimal downtime.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are published; serviceability features are available as specified; customer replaceable parts validated by field trials.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Supplies
requirements.Description: Use keyed bottles for ink supplies to prevent incorrect refill and enhance user experience.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces errors and operational issues for SMBs without IT expertise.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles are used in all supply SKUs; validated by compatibility and usability tests.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Performance Improvement
requirements.Description: Improve PDL SKU speed to 25/20 ppm (from current 25/19), with PDL/PS support and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Better performance and compliance for SMBs needing advanced printing features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves specified speeds; supports PDL/PS; Blue Angel certification obtained.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% RCP
requirements.Description: Ensure printer contains at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP), surpassing competitor offerings.
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator; aligns with market trends and customer values.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product BOM shows >60% RCP; validated by third-party certification.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Support mobile printing through HP app for ease of use and accessibility.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require flexible printing options for a mobile workforce.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing is fully supported via HP app; validated by user acceptance tests.

requirements.Title: PaaS Support
requirements.Description: Enable Printer-as-a-Service (PaaS) features for Magellan, including subscription and management options.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s strategic goal for PaaS acceleration and coverage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features available and functional for SMB customers; validated by pilot programs.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Integrate telemetry features for remote monitoring, diagnostics, and usage analytics to support SMB portal and serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support, device management, and analytics for SMBs and HP.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is accessible and actionable via SMB portal; validated by integration tests.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View Portal
requirements.Description: Support SMB2.0 solutions and advanced view SMB portal for non-PDL SKUs, enhancing manageability and workflow.
requirements.Rationale: Provides differentiated solutions for SMBs with varying needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKUs are compatible with SMB2.0 solutions and advanced view portal; validated by feature tests.

requirements.Title: Tank Powerhouse with Minimal Maintenance
requirements.Description: Design tank printer with minimal parts to replace over its lifetime, aiming for maintenance-free or reduced maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces operational burden and cost for SMBs; differentiates from competitors.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer requires fewer maintenance interventions than competitors; validated by lifecycle testing.

requirements.Title: Solutions Monetization
requirements.Description: Enable monetization of AI and device management solutions within SMB portal over next 3-5 years.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s business goals and innovation strategy.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Monetization features are implemented and generate revenue; validated by business analysis.
